annotations.title: SGPA needed for a target CGPA

description: Average SGPA needed in the remaining semesters to finish with a target CGPA, plus the highest CGPA still reachable. Credit-weighted mode needs completed_credits and credits_per_remaining_semester; equal-average mode needs completed_semesters.

scale_max.description: Grading scale maximum, e.g. 10 for Indian universities, 4 for US GPA. Default 10.
